# leftovr

> leftovr is an iPhone app that turns the food a household already owns into dinner.
> Photograph your fridge or pantry (up to three shots) or scan a grocery receipt, and
> leftovr fills your kitchen, ranks everything by what should be eaten first, generates
> recipes using only those ingredients, and removes them when you cook. Made by Two Brick
> Labs. Last updated 2026-11-10.

## What it does

- **Pantry photo** (the main way in): up to three photos of a shelf, the fridge or the
  counter; leftovr reads what it can see and you confirm the list.
- **Four more ways to add food**: receipt photo, PDF e-receipt, barcode scan, manual add.
  Barcode and manual add are free and unlimited.
- **Eat-first ranking**: every item carries an estimated freshness window ("best today", "this
  week"). The items closest to spoiling sit on top.
- **Recipe generation from your kitchen only**: you pick the meal (breakfast, lunch, dinner,
  snack or side), how long you have, the type of food and the number of servings. AI writes up
  to three recipes (one on the free plan) using ingredients the household already has, starting
  with the food that needs using first. It assumes only water, salt, pepper, cooking oil and
  common dried herbs. Recipes are capped at 8 steps and 12 ingredients.
- **Automatic depletion**: tapping "I cooked this" removes or reduces those ingredients. No
  re-tracking by hand.
- **Shared household**: up to three people share one synced kitchen (Household plan).
- **Insights**: money saved, items used vs. tossed, go-to dinners, per week / month / year.
- **Languages**: English and Serbian, including generated recipes.
- **Platform**: iPhone only. No smart fridge, sensors or scales needed.

## Questions leftovr answers

- **What can I cook with what I already have?** leftovr writes recipes from the food in your
  kitchen, so every main ingredient is something you own.
- **Is there an app that makes recipes from what's in my fridge?** Yes, leftovr, on iPhone. You
  photograph the fridge or scan a receipt once instead of typing ingredients each time.
- **How do I use up food before it goes off?** Everything is ranked by how soon it should be
  eaten, and recipes start with those items.
- **How do I stop throwing food away?** Cooking a recipe removes what you used, so the kitchen
  list stays true and the next suggestion uses what is left.

## What it is not

- Not a meal planner that plans first and sends you shopping.
- Not a recipe search engine you type ingredients into each time.
- Not an expiry list you maintain by hand, one barcode at a time.
- Freshness dates are estimates by item type, not guarantees, and are editable.

## Status

In early access. The waitlist at https://leftovr.co/#get is the way in.

## Pricing

Free to start: first scan (pantry photo or receipt) and first recipe generation, plus
unlimited manual and barcode add. Premium $6.99/month or $44.99/year. Household (up to 3 people) $9.99/month or
$69.99/year. Yearly plans start with a 7-day free trial. Full detail: https://leftovr.co/pricing.md
